There are material reporting inconsistencies, including Amazon Books versus Amazon Toys and NDCG@20 sensitivity plots despite selecting and evaluating top-6 lists. The assertion that all gains are significant gives no number of runs, variance, test samples, or multiple-comparison treatment.
